package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

type LearningTargetType string

const (
	LearningTargetConcept    LearningTargetType = "concept"
	LearningTargetCapability LearningTargetType = "capability"
)

// LearningTargetRef is provider-neutral: the stable key may be resolved by any
// canonical curriculum source without coupling the event to that service.
type LearningTargetRef struct {
	Type    LearningTargetType `json:"type"`
	Key     string             `json:"key"`
	Version string             `json:"version,omitempty"`
}

type TeacherSupportContext string

const (
	TeacherSupportIndependent TeacherSupportContext = "independent"
	TeacherSupportGuided      TeacherSupportContext = "guided"
)

type TeacherAssistanceObservationKind string

const (
	TeacherObservationIndependentContext TeacherAssistanceObservationKind = "independent_context"
	TeacherObservationGuidedContext      TeacherAssistanceObservationKind = "guided_context"
	TeacherObservationHintUsed           TeacherAssistanceObservationKind = "hint_used"
	TeacherObservationIntervention       TeacherAssistanceObservationKind = "intervention"
)

type TeacherAssistanceObservation struct {
	Target LearningTargetRef                `json:"target"`
	Kind   TeacherAssistanceObservationKind `json:"kind"`
}

// LearningActionAssistance is an auditable teacher-owned summary. It records
// help supplied during one learning action and never claims an outcome/mastery.
type LearningActionAssistance struct {
	ID                string
	PersonalTeacherID string
	StudentID         string
	CorrelationID     string
	CausationID       string
	LearningActionID  string
	ContextType       LearningContextType
	ContextID         string
	SupportContext    TeacherSupportContext
	HintsUsed         int
	MaxHintLevel      *int
	InterventionUsed  bool
	Observations      []TeacherAssistanceObservation
	PolicyVersion     string
	CreatedAt         time.Time
}

// LearningActionAssistanceEventData is the public v1 data payload. Persistence
// identities stay private to the teacher service.
type LearningActionAssistanceEventData struct {
	LearningActionID string                         `json:"learning_action_id"`
	ContextType      LearningContextType            `json:"context_type"`
	ContextID        string                         `json:"context_id,omitempty"`
	SupportContext   TeacherSupportContext          `json:"support_context"`
	HintsUsed        int                            `json:"hints_used"`
	MaxHintLevel     *int                           `json:"max_hint_level,omitempty"`
	InterventionUsed bool                           `json:"intervention_used"`
	Observations     []TeacherAssistanceObservation `json:"observations"`
	PolicyVersion    string                         `json:"policy_version"`
}

func (assistance LearningActionAssistance) EventData() LearningActionAssistanceEventData {
	return LearningActionAssistanceEventData{
		LearningActionID: assistance.LearningActionID,
		ContextType:      assistance.ContextType,
		ContextID:        assistance.ContextID,
		SupportContext:   assistance.SupportContext,
		HintsUsed:        assistance.HintsUsed,
		MaxHintLevel:     assistance.MaxHintLevel,
		InterventionUsed: assistance.InterventionUsed,
		Observations:     assistance.Observations,
		PolicyVersion:    assistance.PolicyVersion,
	}
}

func NewLearningActionAssistance(input LearningActionAssistance) (LearningActionAssistance, error) {
	input.ID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ID)
	input.PersonalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PersonalTeacherID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.CorrelationID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CorrelationID)
	input.CausationID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CausationID)
	input.LearningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningActionID)
	input.ContextID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ContextID)
	input.PolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PolicyVersion)
	input.CreatedAt = input.CreatedAt.UTC()

	if !validUUID(input.ID) || !validUUID(input.PersonalTeacherID) || !validUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		!validUUID(input.CorrelationID) || !validUUID(input.CausationID) ||
		!validUUID(input.LearningActionID) || input.CorrelationID != input.LearningActionID || !validClosedActionContextType(input.ContextType) ||
		!validSupportContext(input.SupportContext) || !validValue(input.PolicyVersion, 64) ||
		input.CreatedAt.IsZero() || input.HintsUsed < 0 || input.HintsUsed > 1000 ||
		len(input.Observations) == 0 || len(input.Observations) > 300 {
		return LearningActionAssistance{}, errors.New("invalid learning action assistance")
	}
	if !validUUID(input.ContextID) {
		return LearningActionAssistance{}, errors.New("context_id is required for contextual assistance")
	}
	if input.HintsUsed == 0 && input.MaxHintLevel != nil {
		return LearningActionAssistance{}, errors.New("max_hint_level requires hints_used")
	}
	if input.HintsUsed > 0 && input.MaxHintLevel == nil {
		return LearningActionAssistance{}, errors.New("max_hint_level is required when hints were used")
	}
	if input.MaxHintLevel != nil && (*input.MaxHintLevel < 0 || *input.MaxHintLevel > 7) {
		return LearningActionAssistance{}, errors.New("max_hint_level must be between 0 and 7")
	}
	if input.SupportContext == TeacherSupportIndependent &&
		(input.HintsUsed != 0 || input.MaxHintLevel != nil || input.InterventionUsed) {
		return LearningActionAssistance{}, errors.New("independent context cannot contain teacher assistance")
	}

	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(input.Observations))
	hasGuidance := false
	hasHint := false
	hasIntervention := false
	for index := range input.Observations {
		observation := &input.Observations[index]
		observation.Target.Key = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Target.Key)
		observation.Target.Version = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Target.Version)
		if !validLearningTargetType(observation.Target.Type) || !validValue(observation.Target.Key, 255) ||
			len(observation.Target.Version) > 128 || !validAssistanceObservationKind(observation.Kind) {
			return LearningActionAssistance{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid assistance observation at index %d", index)
		}
		if input.SupportContext == TeacherSupportIndependent && observation.Kind != TeacherObservationIndependentContext {
			return LearningActionAssistance{}, errors.New("independent context accepts only independent observations")
		}
		if input.SupportContext == TeacherSupportGuided && observation.Kind == TeacherObservationIndependentContext {
			return LearningActionAssistance{}, errors.New("guided context cannot contain independent observations")
		}
		switch observation.Kind {
		case TeacherObservationGuidedContext:
			hasGuidance = true
		case TeacherObservationHintUsed:
			hasGuidance = true
			hasHint = true
		case TeacherObservationIntervention:
			hasGuidance = true
			hasIntervention = true
		}

		key := string(observation.Target.Type) + "\x00" + observation.Target.Key + "\x00" + observation.Target.Version + "\x00" + string(observation.Kind)
		if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
			return LearningActionAssistance{}, errors.New("duplicate assistance observation")
		}
		seen[key] = struct{}{}
	}
	if input.SupportContext == TeacherSupportGuided && !hasGuidance {
		return LearningActionAssistance{}, errors.New("guided context requires a guidance observation")
	}
	if (input.HintsUsed > 0) != hasHint {
		return LearningActionAssistance{}, errors.New("hint aggregate does not match observations")
	}
	if input.InterventionUsed != hasIntervention {
		return LearningActionAssistance{}, errors.New("intervention aggregate does not match observations")
	}
	return input, nil
}

func validLearningTargetType(value LearningTargetType) bool {
	return value == LearningTargetConcept || value == LearningTargetCapability
}

func validSupportContext(value TeacherSupportContext) bool {
	return value == TeacherSupportIndependent || value == TeacherSupportGuided
}

func validAssistanceObservationKind(value TeacherAssistanceObservationKind) bool {
	switch value {
	case TeacherObservationIndependentContext, TeacherObservationGuidedContext, TeacherObservationHintUsed, TeacherObservationIntervention:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}
